alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The duodenum is the first portion of the small intestine and has villi like the rest of the small intestine. This section can be further identified as duodenum because of the presence of Brunner's glands, which are located in the submucosa. These mucus-secreting, submucosal glands are found only in the duodenal portion of the small intestine.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. A Peyer's patch is an accumulation of lymphoid nodules in the lamina propria of the ileum. Lymphoid tissue can occur in this location along the entire digestive tract; however, the term Peyer's patch is reserved for these large accumulations in the ileum. Accumulations of lymphoid tissue appear highly basophilic due to the presence of large numbers of lymphocytes.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. A plica circularis is a circular fold extending around the entire inner circumference of the small intestine. Each plica has a central core of submucosa covered by the overlying mucosa with its villi. In contrast, a villus has a core of lamina propria that is overlain by the simple columnar epithelium lining the small intestine.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The muscularis externa is the outer muscular layer of the digestive tract and usually consists of inner circular and outer longitudinal layers of smooth muscle. Beyond the muscularis externa is the adventitia which is some regions of the digestive tract is covered by a mesothelium (visceral peritoneum); it which case it forms a serosa.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The pancreas is both an exocrine and endocrine gland. The exocrine portion is classified as a compound acinar gland, and the highly-polarized cells that compose the acini are clearly visible in this field. The endocrine portion is composed of islets of Langerhans, which appear as spherical clusters of pale-staining cells.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The portal triad of the liver contains the hepatic artery, hepatic portal vein and bile duct. The hepatic artery has a thick muscular wall and simple squamous epithelium (endothelium); the bile duct is distinguished by its simple cuboidal or low columnar epithelium. The portal vein has a thin wall and often contains red blood cells.

In the fundic stomach, the pits are much shorter than the glands.
